note: After the 11/12 parts arrived, COX ordered a second part (exhaust temp sensor) on 11/13 with 'called vendor and ordered. will be in Monday', then on 11/16 'parts are expected Monday' and 'part will be in, in the morning'. None of these produce a parts ETC mention: the partsArrival keywords need 'parts will be in' / 'parts ETA' next to a date, and 'will be in Monday' has no 'parts' and 'in the morning' is not a supported relative form. The row keeps partsEta '2026-11-12' (5 days past). On the live row partsStatus 'ordered' comes only from the 11/04 'parts have been ordered' comment; 'called vendor and ordered' (11/13) is the M1 pattern and is not extracted, so with these four comments alone partsStatus is ''.
